meta.title: C-2: the one comparison that isolates the paper's mechanism
meta.source: C-2; identical world model, policy, link and protocol. Each arm's threshold tuned so the two match on task success within 0.7 pp (fidelity 78.2% vs. ActDelta 78.9% on LIBERO)
meta.notes: The percentage annotations above the bars are the reduction of `sys` against `fidelity` for the same benchmark. They are stored as their own scalars rather than recomputed in TeX, so after a data replacement recompute them -- a stale -60% over changed bars is the failure mode to watch for.
